    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int64_t N, M, L, R;
    cin >> N >> M >> L >> R;
    
    const int64_t mod = 998244353;
    mpz_class MOD(mod);
    int64_t len = R - L + 1;
    int64_t E = len / 2 + ((R % 2 == 0 && L % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0);
    int64_t O = len - E;
    int64_t nm = N * M;
    mpz_class ans;

    mpz_class base1(E + O);
    mpz_class base2(E - O);
    mpz_class nm_mpz(nm);
    
    if (nm % 2 == 1) {
        mpz_powm(ans.get_mpz_t(), base1.get_mpz_t(), nm_mpz.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());
    } else {
        mpz_class part1, part2;
        mpz_powm(part1.get_mpz_t(), base1.get_mpz_t(), nm_mpz.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());
        mpz_powm(part2.get_mpz_t(), base2.get_mpz_t(), nm_mpz.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());
        ans = (part1 + part2) % MOD;
        
        mpz_class inv2;
        mpz_class two(2);
        mpz_class exp = MOD - 2;
        mpz_powm(inv2.get_mpz_t(), two.get_mpz_t(), exp.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());
        ans = (ans * inv2) % MOD;
    }
    
    cout << ans.get_si() << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
